cohort: 75 intramural neonates (36 twins and 1 triplet) delivered with multiple gestations at a Level III neonatal intensive care unit of a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Multiple gestations are associated with significant neonatal complications, primarily due to prematurity and low birth weight.
birth_weight: <2.5 kg for 98% of neonates; <=1.5 kg for a subset
